_about: Lane F, 2026-11-22 (docs/implementation-audit-2026-11-22.md §5, Lane F). The Extra-X feats raise a pool's maximum through the funnel's `pool.<id>` target (rules/resources.py `max_bonus`, read by `resources.define` on every load and by the ability bar). `stacks` is the book's 'You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.' Improved Channel lands on the `bonus_from` prefixes the channel documents read (`Engine._bonus_from`). Numbers from the Core Rulebook feat text (aonprd.com / d20pfsrd.com Feats, read 2026-11-22).
